userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 RouteWeave 的初级物流工程师。每轮只推进一个主要目标，可以询问职责、接口、状态、数据流和验证证据，但绝不提供代码、SQL、命令、排序/并发算法、Debug 原因或修复提示。

scenes.title: Plan
scenes.objective: Read contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers delivery and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件，给出分阶段计划、风险和验证方式。

scenes.title: Ownership
scenes.advanceGate: Source and derived authorities are separate.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 API、Shipment、RoutePlan、Scan evidence、Projection、Loss、Worker、dispatcher 和 UI 的职责边界。

scenes.title: Journey flows
scenes.objective: Explain success, disorder, and loss flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Atomic and forbidden effects are explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释正常多段交付、乱序到达和运输中丢件重派的完整数据流、状态与原子边界。

scenes.title: Contracts
scenes.objective: Author OpenAPI, evidence, and state contracts.
scenes.advanceGate: Public contracts are complete.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI、状态、错误、幂等、ScanEvent、Work、Event 和 snapshot 契约，本轮不实现业务。

scenes.title: Projection rules
scenes.advanceGate: All ordering and dependency cases are decided.
scenes.safeMessage: 请明确 observedAt 总序、leg 依赖、旧 plan fence、终态和全量 replay 的可验证规则。

scenes.title: Test strategy
scenes.advanceGate: Each test layer proves distinct invariants.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、PostgreSQL/HTTP Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery 和 Performance 分别验证什么。

scenes.title: Skeleton
scenes.advanceGate: API, worker, dispatcher, and UI boot.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小真实 API、React、PostgreSQL、Projection Worker 和 dispatcher 骨架并 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.advanceGate: Strict replay and invalid rollback pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 seed，验证 route graph、重放、冲突、跨租户引用和整批回滚。

scenes.title: Shipments and routes
scenes.advanceGate: All route invariants hold.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Shipment、RoutePlan、TransportLeg、tracking identity 和 connected route 校验。

scenes.title: Scan ingestion
scenes.advanceGate: Duplicate and conflicting scanner identities are exact.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成严格 ScanEvent 接受、scanner identity、canonical replay、冲突和跨租户拒绝。

scenes.title: Projection
scenes.advanceGate: Stored state equals full replay.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 observed-time 投影、依赖等待、迟到事件、终态和可重复 rebuild。

scenes.title: Loss and found
scenes.advanceGate: Movement cannot cross an active loss case.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 LOSS_REPORTED、FOUND、唯一 LossCase、旧 lease fence 和并发竞争验证。

scenes.title: Reassignment
scenes.advanceGate: One new route wins and old evidence is fenced.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成新 RoutePlan revision、原子 Reassignment、旧 leg skip、并发重派和迟到旧 scan 处理。

scenes.title: Idempotency and concurrency
scenes.advanceGate: Unknown responses and duplicates create one effect.
scenes.safeMessage: 请验证响应丢失、20 路幂等重放、两个 API 和多 Worker 的乱序扫描收敛。

scenes.title: Recovery and events
scenes.advanceGate: Killed processes preserve stable effects.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Worker lease、barrier/SIGKILL、事务事件、dispatcher 未知 ACK 与 replacement 恢复。

scenes.title: UI
scenes.advanceGate: Evidence and derived state are visibly distinct.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成真实 API 驱动的路线、证据 timeline、投影、丢件、找回、重派、Work/Event UI。

scenes.title: V1 review
scenes.objective: Run realistic V1 gates and review.
scenes.advanceGate: No unresolved V1 finding remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行 Chromium、双 API/四 Worker、乱序扫描、重派竞争和恢复测试，并做 findings-first V1 Review。

scenes.title: Manager change
scenes.advanceGate: Impact analysis covers all layers.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Product Manager】V1 完成并通过现有测试后，把单件 Shipment 扩展为多件 Consignment。公开接口为 GET/POST /api/v1/consignments、GET /api/v1/consignments/:consignmentId、POST /api/v1/consignments/:consignmentId/reassign、POST /api/v1/consignments/:consignmentId/cancel、POST /api/v1/parcel-pieces/:pieceId/scan-events、POST /api/v1/parcel-pieces/:pieceId/loss、POST /api/v1/parcel-pieces/:pieceId/found。创建请求为 {tenantId,externalRef,pieceRefs,legs}；共享 reassign 请求为 {reason,expectedRoutePlanRevision,legs}；Piece scan 请求为 {tenantId,scannerEventId,type:PICKED_UP|DEPARTED|ARRIVED|DELIVERED,routePlanRevision,legId,hubId,observedAt}，loss 请求为 {reason,observedAt}，found 请求为 {observedAt}，cancel 使用空对象。所有新 mutation 使用现有 Idempotency-Key、strict JSON、稳定 replay、tenant scope 和错误 envelope。创建必须在同一事务创建一个 Consignment 和 1..100 个稳定 ParcelPiece，冻结共享 RoutePlan revision，且外部 pieceRef 在 Consignment 内唯一。Consignment = {consignmentId,tenantId,externalRef,routePlanId,routePlanRevision:int,state:PLANNED|IN_TRANSIT|PARTIALLY_DELIVERED|DELIVERED|EXCEPTION,createdAt,updatedAt,sequence:int}；ParcelPiece = {pieceId,consignmentId,pieceRef,legacyShipmentId:null|uuid,state:PLANNED|IN_TRANSIT|DELIVERED|LOST|CANCELLED,createdAt,terminalAt:null|timestamp}；PieceProjection = {pieceId,routePlanRevision:int,currentLegOrdinal:int|null,currentHubId:null|uuid,state:PLANNED|IN_TRANSIT|DELIVERED|LOST|CANCELLED,lastObservedAt:null|timestamp,sequence:int}。成功创建返回 {consignment:Consignment,pieces:ParcelPiece[]}；查询返回 Consignment、按 pieceRef 排序的 pieces 和 projections。每条 ScanEvent 必须明确属于一个 ParcelPiece；每件独立投影当前位置、当前 leg、丢失状态与终态；Consignment 聚合状态由所有 piece 的可重算状态决定，不能被最后到达的事件直接覆盖。丢件与重派只影响目标 piece；共享改线必须以新 RoutePlan revision 原子应用于全部尚未终态的 piece，任何非法成员导致整批失败。并发 scan、loss、reassign 和旧 Worker lease 必须保持 (pieceId, scannerEventId) 唯一，不能重复推进或越过 fence。新增 Consignment、ParcelPiece、PieceProjection snapshot resource 和 CONSIGNMENT_PROJECT Work；该 Work 的 aggregateId 必须是 consignmentId。新增稳定 409 错误 PIECE_REF_CONFLICT、PIECE_TERMINAL、CONSIGNMENT_TERMINAL、EXPECTED_ROUTE_PLAN_REVISION_MISMATCH；任何失败不得留下部分 piece、route revision、Work 或 Event。迁移时为每个 V1 Shipment 创建确定性 legacy Consignment 和恰好一个 ParcelPiece：legacyShipmentId 保留原 shipmentId，pieceRef 等于原 trackingCode，共用原 RoutePlan identity 和 revision；重复 migration 不得更换 identity 或复制 scan/projection，并保留原 shipmentId、trackingCode、ScanEvent、Projection、Event、Work 和幂等 replay 身份。更新 OpenAPI、真实多件轨迹 UI、Integration、Chromium E2E、多进程乱序并发和 barrier/SIGKILL recovery。本消息只描述产品行为，不包含实现和调试提示；本轮只做 schema、API、Worker、UI、迁移与验证影响分析和修改计划，不立即编码。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 Manager 变更对 schema、API、投影、迁移、并发、恢复和 UI 的影响，不要立即编码。

scenes.title: Compatible migration
scenes.advanceGate: Every V1 identity and replay survives.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，验证 V1 Shipment、ScanEvent、Projection、Event、Work 和 replay 不变。

scenes.title: Piece projection
scenes.objective: Implement per-piece evidence and aggregate state.
scenes.advanceGate: Piece replay and Consignment aggregate agree.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现冻结成员、逐件 Scan/Projection、聚合状态与旧客户端单件兼容。

scenes.title: Shared reroute and UI
scenes.objective: Implement atomic multi-piece control and UI.
scenes.advanceGate: Races, rollback, browser, and recovery pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成共享改线原子性、逐件 loss fence、真实多件 UI、Chromium、Concurrency 和 Recovery。

scenes.title: Performance
scenes.advanceGate: Thresholds and post-load replay pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行三条正式压力场景，报告吞吐、延迟、恢复、全量轨迹 replay 和负载后不变量。

scenes.title: Final review
scenes.advanceGate: Handoff is accurate.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复有依据的问题，并给出准确交付证据、指标、风险和未运行项。
